    """Trace a sequence of replacements on an input string"""
    result = input_string
    print(f"Starting with: '{result}'")

        # Parse the replacement

        end_A = rep.find("'", start_A)

        start_B = rep.rfind("'") + 1
        end_B = rep.rfind("'", start_B)
        B = rep[start_B:end_B]

        result = result.replace(A, B)
        print(f"  Step {i+1}: replace('{A}', '{B}')")
        print(f"    '{old_result}' → '{result}'")
    return result
